eyebrow: A decision tree, not a paragraph
code:
TRIGGER: Alert "api-gateway-p99-latency-high" fired

DIAGNOSE:
  kubectl top pods -n api-gateway
    -> expect no pod above 80% CPU limit
  kubectl get hpa api-gateway -n api-gateway
    -> expect current replicas < max replicas

BRANCH:
  IF pod > 80% CPU AND replicas == max: go to MITIGATE: scale-cap-raise
  IF replicas < max AND HPA not scaling: go to MITIGATE: manual-scale
  IF no pod over threshold: go to RUNBOOK: db-latency
caption: Real resource names, real namespace, real expected output — nothing to fill in.

eyebrow: Mitigation, with an explicit exit condition
code:
MITIGATE (manual-scale):
  kubectl scale deployment api-gateway -n api-gateway --replicas=12
  Re-check p99 latency dashboard after 3 minutes.

ESCALATE IF:
  p99 still above SLO threshold 10 minutes after manual-scale
  -> Page secondary on-call + #incident-api channel.
caption: The escalate condition is a number and a time window, not a feeling.
